PROCEEDING AS PLANNED.Text: Search the project deck for 1 card of your choice and assign this leader to that mission. Then shuffle your project deck.

SON OF SKYWALKER.Text: After you succeed at a mission in this leader's system, search your mission deck for the "Seek Yoda" or "Daring Rescue" card and place it in your hand.  Then shuffle your mission deck.

UNDERCOVER.Text: Use when your opponent attempts a mission, before rolling dice.  Move this leader from any system to the mission's system.

START THE EVACUATION.Text: Place this leader in any system that does not contain Imperial units.  Then move any of your units from the "Rebel Base" space to this system as if they were adjacent.

PUBLIC SUPPORT.Text: Place this leader in any Imperial system that does not contain a Rebel ground unit. Gain 3 stormtroopers in the system. This leader does not prevent you from moving units out of this system this round.

IT'S A TRAP.Text: During the first round of combat, your opponent cannot play space tactic cards.

GOOD INTEL.Text: The Rebel player must keep his hand of tactic cards faceup. If using advanced tactic cards, you do not choose a tactic card until after the Rebel player's card has been revealed each round.

HUMAN-CYBORG RELATIONS.Text: Attach the C-3PO ring to any leader.  When you fail a diplomacy mission in C-3PO's system, discard this ring to make the mission succeed instead.

SECRET FACILITY.Text: Place 1 of your probe cards facedown below this card. At the start of your turn in the Command Phase, you may reveal that probe card to gain 1 ▲ unit and 1 Shield Bunker in the card's system. Then resolve a combat in that system and discard this action card.

OUR MOST DESPERATE HOUR.Text: Search your mission deck for 1 card of your choice and assign this leader to that mission.  Then shuffle your mission deck.

EARLY PROMOTION.Text: Either draw 1 starting Action Card or Recruit Admiral Motti.  If you recruit Admiral Motti, place him and Grand Moff Tarkin in an Imperial System.

AMBUSH.Text: Place this leader in any system.  Destroy up to 3-health worth of Imperial ground units of your choice in this system.

ONE IN A MILLION.Text: use during either a combat or a mission.  Instead of rolling up to 2 of your dice, place them on the table showing the results of your choice.

LORD VADER'S ORDERS.Text: Look at the top 3 cards of the objective deck, then place them on top of the deck in any order.

BRILLIANT ADMINISTRATOR.Text: Place this leader in any Imperial system. Then place units on the build queue using this system's resource icons and number.

MORE DANGEROUS THAN YOU REALIZE.Text: Draw either 3 space tactic cards or 3 ground tactic cards.

TEMPORARY ALLIANCE.Text: Place this leader in any neutral system.  Then place units on the build queue using this system's resource icons and number.

AMBITIONS OF POWER.Text: Use when you have more than 8 leaders in your leader pool. Until the end of the game, your leader pool limit is increased by 1.

WOOKIEE GUARDIAN.Text: Use when your opponent attempts a spec ops mission, before rolling dice.  The mission automatically failes.

LOCAL RUMORS.Text: Place this leader in any system that contains an Imperial unit. The Rebel player must state whether the Rebel base is in this region.

READY FOR ACTION.Text: Take this leader from your leader pool and place him in this system. This leader cannot retreat, and he returns to your leader pool at the end of the combat.

TARGET THE GENERATOR.Text: Destroy 1 structure of your choice in this system.

BLINDSIDE.Text: Use before revealing this leader's mission. Your opponent cannot send leaders from his leader pool to oppose this mission.

AN OLD FRIEND.Text: Place this leader in either the Bespin system to recruit Lando Calrissian or in the Kashyyyk system to recruit Chewbacca.  Place ther recruited leader in Han Solo's system.

CATCH THEM BY SURPRISE.Text: Place this leader in any system. Then move Imperial units from adjacent systems to this system. If there are Rebel units in this system, resolve a combat.

IT IS YOUR DESTINY.Text: Use during a mission after a leader is rescued. Capture 1 leader who attempted this mission.

BOBA FETT? WHERE?.Text: Place this leader in any Imperial system. During the next Command Phase, Rebel leaders cannot attempt missions in this system or use action cards in this system.

CLONE TRAINER.Text: Either draw 1 starting action card or recruit Captain Rex. If you recruit Captain Rex, place him on a starting Rebel system. Move all setup units not in the "Rebel Base" to this system.

RESOURCEFUL ASTROMECH.Text: Attach the R2-D2 ring to any leader.  After your opponent rolls dice during a mission in R2-D2's system, discard this ring to turn 1 of your opponent's dice to its blank side.

SCOUTING MISSION.Text: Place this leader in any system. Then move up to 4 TIE Fighters from any system(s) to this system, ignoring transport restrictions and adjacency. If there are Rebel ships in this system, resolve a combat.

INDEPENDENT OPERATION.Text: Place this leader in any subjugated system.  The Imperial player must move all his ground units from this system to any 1 Imperial system of this choice, ignoring adjacency and transport capacity.

POINT-BLANK ASSAULT.Text: All units in this system have -1 health, to a minimum of 1.

FULLY OPERATIONAL.Text: If either a Death Star or Death Star Under Construction is in this system, destroy 1 Rebel ship of your choice in the system.

THE MILLENNIUM FALCON.Text: Attach the Millennium Falcon ring to this leader.  After you succeed at a mission in the Millennium Falcon's system, discard this ring to rescue 1 captured leader in this system.

POWER FACILITY RAID.Text: Place 1 sabotage marker in any populous system adjacent to a system with Rebel loyalty.

NOBLE SACRIFICE.Text: Use when this leader becomes captured.  He is eliminated and you gain 1 reputation.

POST BOUNTY.Text: Use after any leader fails a mission in this leader's system. Attach the bounty ring to any Rebel leader that does not have a ring in this system. When that leader is captured, the Rebels lose 1 reputation.

SWEEP THE AREA.Text: Place 1 of your probe cards facedown below this card. At the end of the Command Phase, you may reveal the probe card to capture a leader in that card's system. Then move that leader to the closest system that contains an Imperial unit and discard this action card.

TRACK THEM.Text: Use after a Rebel unit retreats from Combat. Choose an Imperial Leader in the combat's system and return it to your leader pool.

ACCORDING TO MY DESIGN.Text: For each battle during the first combat round, the Rebel player rolls 1 fewer red die and 2 fewer black die.

TARGET THE STAR DESTROYERS.Text: During the space battle of each combat round, treat up to 2 of your black hits as red hits.

OUR FOCUS MUST BE ON PEACE.Text: Either draw 1 starting action card or recruit Bail Organa. If you recruit Bail Organa, place him and Mon Mothma on a Rebel system.
